title: SpaceX Just Made an $8 BILLION Move… Here's the Opportunity
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: SpaceX's $8B purchase of 800 MHz low-band spectrum plus 15,000 new satellites is a real threat that could push legacy carriers into a price war and thinner profits.

calls.condition: If T-Mobile holds market share it could double over a couple of years; if SpaceX wins share it is 'heading straight to bankruptcy court'. Watch Oct 28 earnings, Nov 5 FCC partner report, Dec 4 satellite filings.
calls.reason: Carriers fell 9-13% on Oct 9 after the spectrum sale; he says the dip is the start of a real threat, not an overreaction, despite TMUS looking cheap at ~13.6x forward earnings.
calls.quote: a lot of people are writing these dips off as a one-day over panic, but I think they're wrong. I think this is the start of a real threat

calls.reason: Only company with rockets, satellites and low-band spectrum; could approach a monopoly in satellite internet plus phone. But says it is overpriced and fair value is about half; hopes to buy cheaper. Analysts' avg 12-mo target ~$222 (not his own).
calls.quote: I was hoping and I'm still hoping for a chance to buy it much cheaper than that, but we may not get it

notes: SpaceX ticker not canonical; used 'SPACEX'. TMUS bias is implied from the threat thesis rather than an explicit sell call; he frames buying TMUS as a bet either way. VZ and T mentioned with same thesis, not separately recorded.
